searchLog: Could not complete the hunt: this session's network egress policy blocks WebFetch to every external domain tried (anthropic.com, databricks.com, scale.com, ramp.com, boards-api.greenhouse.io, api.ashbyhq.com, job-boards.greenhouse.io, google.com, drive.google.com, wikipedia.org, even example.com) — only github.com resolved. WebSearch still works and surfaced live-looking leads (Databricks 'Associate Product Manager, New Grad 2027 Start' opened Jul 16 2026; Scale AI 'Strategic Projects Lead - New Grad (2026 Season)'; Ramp emerging-talent FDE openings) but hunt.md's rule 2 requires confirming eligibility/deadline/open-status from the actual page before including anything, and that verification step is impossible under this network policy. Rather than include unverified snippet-only leads, writing zero opportunities is the honest result per hunt.md: '0 verified opportunities is honest; 5 unverified is noise.'
